Amir — thanks, that's super helpful. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2 Type II report: yes, we can share the most recent report (2026).
- Pen test: we provide an executive summary of the most recent external pen test (redacted for customer-facing sharing) and can provide additional detail under an NDA if required.

- Audit logs: we can provide an export (CSV) of relevant audit events and a short doc describing retention windows and granularity.
- Data retention: our default retention and configurable retention options are documented — we'll attach a short Q&A specific to Quantix's questions.
